name: Shipping Label

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you may encounter Durotar Supply and Logistics while traveling through the Barrens. Its work helps keep trade and supplies moving between Durotar and central Kalimdor.

faq.answer: The Shipping Label is a torn document fixed to a freshly restocked crate, with return instructions for Durotar Supply and Logistics and directions back to its post near the Crossroads.

aliases: where do i take the shipping label
faq.answer: The label directs couriers to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub west of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
faq.q: Where should the label be delivered?

aliases: what is durotar supply and logistics
faq.answer: Durotar Supply and Logistics is a freight company in Horde territory. It handles cargo transport, crate collection, and logistical support across Durotar and the Barrens.
faq.q: What is Durotar Supply and Logistics?

aliases: who was the crate meant for
faq.answer: The recipient's name has been torn away, leaving the return instructions and the company's origin information on the crate.
faq.q: Who was the shipment originally intended for?

faq.answer: The label's directions and rough map place the outpost west of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
faq.q: Where is the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost located?

aliases: do they pay for returned crates
faq.answer: Yes. The notice promises compensation for travelers who bring damaged shipments, labels, or empty crates to the hub.
faq.q: Does Durotar Supply and Logistics compensate travelers for returning crates?

sections.body: A torn manifest is fixed to a freshly restocked cargo crate. Its recipient's name has worn away, but the heading names Durotar Supply and Logistics, a freight company in Horde territory. Beside the writing, a rough map points couriers toward the company's staging grounds in the central plains.
sections.title: A Wayward Manifest

sections.body: The notice welcomes travelers bringing stray containers, damaged goods, or proof of salvage to the trade outpost west of the Crossroads. Durotar Supply and Logistics depends on independent haulers to recover scattered freight across the Barrens. Those who help keep regional supplies moving receive compensation.
sections.title: Frontier Commerce

summary: A torn manifest points couriers toward Durotar Supply and Logistics in the Barrens. The company depends on travelers to recover lost crates and return paperwork to its post west of the Crossroads, keeping supplies and trade moving across central Kalimdor.
